A dog named Jinny, who passed away in 2005, went down in history as the dog who was obsessed with cats. The moment she was adopted from the shelter, she started tracking down stray cats and dragging them home to her owner.
She pulled them out of pipes, dumpsters, and cardboard boxes. Word spread fast throughout the neighborhood — her owner Philip Gonzalez set up a cat rescue fund in Jinny's name, and locals started dropping off stray cats there themselves.
In the end, thanks to Jinny and her fund, over 900 cats were saved. In 1998, the Westchester Cat Fanciers Club honored her with the title of "Cat of the Year."
